  • Method Details

    • invoke

      public static Object invoke(Class<?> theClass, Object anInstance, String methodName) throws TestingException, Throwable
      Utility/convenience method to invoke an instance or static method with no arguments
      Parameters:
      theClass - the class for the static method invocation
      anInstance - the instance context for the method invocation - will be null for static methods
      methodName - the name of the method to execute
      Returns:
      any value or object returned by the method - if the named method returns a primitive type, the value will be wrapped - if the method is void, then null
      Throws:
      TestingException - any wrapped exceptions which may be thrown by reflection
      Throwable - anything thrown by the named method

    • invoke

      public static Object invoke(Class<?> theClass, Object anInstance, String methodName, Class<?>[] parameterTypes, Object... arguments) throws TestingException, Throwable
      Utility method to invoke an instance or static method
      Parameters:
      theClass - the class for the static method invocation
      anInstance - the instance context for the method invocation - will be null for static methods
      methodName - the name of the method to execute
      parameterTypes - the types of the method's parameters
      arguments - any parameters to pass to the method
      Returns:
      any value or object returned by the method - if the named method returns a primitive type, the value will be wrapped - if the method is void, then null
      Throws:
      TestingException - any wrapped exceptions which may be thrown by reflection
      Throwable - anything thrown by the named method
